title: Open April with a Baseline
teaser: A goal is easier to evaluate when you know exactly where you started.
full_text: Choose one area you want to improve by the end of April and record today's state in a measurable way. Give your future review something more useful than memory or mood to compare against.

title: Find the Actual Owner of One Stalled Item
teaser: Work can sit idle when responsibility is assumed rather than named.
full_text: Pick one item that is waiting and identify who truly owns the next decision or delivery. Remove overlapping assumptions about ownership before adding more reminders.

title: Remove One Small Risk While It Is Cheap
teaser: Minor exposures are easiest to ignore before they become expensive.
full_text: Choose one risk that can be reduced with little effort today: an expiring document, a weak backup, a missing approval, or a payment that could be forgotten. Close the loop before urgency raises the cost.

title: Turn One Note into a Decision
teaser: Notes create value only when they influence what happens next.
full_text: Open one recent note and separate what needs a decision, a follow-up, or no further attention. Give the useful part a next action instead of allowing it to remain passive information.

title: Find the Most Fragmented Part of Your Week
teaser: Interruptions can reduce useful time even when the calendar looks full enough.
full_text: Look back at the hours when focused work was broken most often. For next week, protect one of those periods by reducing meetings, alerts, or small administrative tasks.

title: Compare Price with Total Cost
teaser: The purchase price is only one part of what something may cost over time.
full_text: For one product or service you are considering, include maintenance, renewals, travel, setup time, subscriptions, or replacement costs. Make the decision against the full burden rather than the first payment.

title: Question One Approval Step
teaser: Controls are useful when they reduce risk, not merely when they extend the queue.
full_text: Review one recurring approval in a process. Identify the failure it is meant to prevent and whether that failure is still relevant. Document the answer before changing the process.

title: End One Message with the Needed Action
teaser: Sharing information does not automatically create movement.
full_text: When sending an important message today, make the expected next step explicit in the closing line. State whether you need a reply, approval, file, decision, or date.

title: Keep the Source Beside the Number
teaser: A useful figure becomes harder to trust when its origin disappears.
full_text: For one important value you use today, record the source, date, and version where relevant. Make it possible to explain a future change without reconstructing the research from memory.

title: List Inputs Before Starting the Work
teaser: Starting early does not help if a missing dependency forces the work to stop halfway through.
full_text: Before beginning one substantial task, list the files, decisions, people, and data it needs. Resolve the missing inputs first when possible so progress is not confused with repeated setup.

title: Review One Default Security Setting
teaser: Default settings are designed for broad use, not necessarily for your risk level.
full_text: Open the privacy, sharing, or session settings of one important service. If access is wider than your actual need, choose a narrower setting and note any consequence before confirming it.

title: Estimate with a Range
teaser: A single estimate can hide uncertainty rather than remove it.
full_text: For one cost or time estimate today, write a reasonable lower and upper bound. Note the assumption most likely to widen the range so the plan shows where uncertainty actually lives.

title: Map Who Is Affected by One Decision
teaser: A decision can create work for people who were never part of the original discussion.
full_text: Before making one meaningful change, list who will be affected. Separate the people who must approve, the people who need advance notice, and those who only need the final information.

title: Give One File Type a Lifecycle
teaser: Keeping everything forever is not the same as managing information well.
full_text: Choose one kind of document and define when it is active, when it becomes archival, and when deletion is appropriate. Make retention a rule you can explain rather than an accident of storage.

title: Reduce One Midmonth Commitment
teaser: Protecting quality sometimes requires changing scope when capacity is lower than expected.
full_text: Find one April commitment that is consuming more time than planned. Consider whether scope, order, or timing can be adjusted deliberately instead of simply compressing the remaining work.

title: Compare a Template with Real Use
teaser: A polished template can still create friction if people constantly rewrite the same parts.
full_text: Review a form, message, or report template people use often. Look for fields or wording that are repeatedly changed and move stable improvements back into the template itself.

title: Remove One Unnecessary Privilege
teaser: Access is easier to govern when it is no broader than the job requires.
full_text: Review one application's administrative or sharing permissions. Verify ownership first, then remove an old account, unused integration, stale device, or privilege that no longer has a clear purpose.

title: Check the Denominator of One Percentage
teaser: A precise percentage can still mislead when its denominator does not match the comparison.
full_text: Choose one rate or percentage you use today. Confirm that numerator and denominator cover the same period, population, and definition before relying on the result.

title: Separate Waiting Decisions from Waiting Work
teaser: Some unfinished tasks are blocked by a choice, not by a lack of effort.
full_text: Review this week's open items and mark the ones that cannot move until a decision is made. Name the decision owner and the missing information so the blockage becomes actionable.

title: Read One Renewal Clause Early
teaser: Options shrink when important contract terms are discovered on the deadline.
full_text: Choose an upcoming subscription, lease, membership, or service renewal and review cancellation, notice, and price-change terms now. Add an earlier decision date if the final deadline leaves too little room.

title: Define What One Experiment Should Teach You
teaser: Trying something new is not the same as designing a useful test.
full_text: Before making one small change today, write what observation would support the idea and what observation would make you reconsider it. Judge the experiment by what you learn, not only by whether you liked the outcome.

title: Transfer Context with the Task
teaser: A handoff fails when the new owner receives an instruction but not the information needed to act.
full_text: When delegating one task, include the purpose, current state, critical file, expected output, and time boundary. Avoid making the next person reconstruct the history from scattered conversations.

title: Extract Actions from One Meeting Note
teaser: Meeting notes that record discussion but not responsibility invite the same conversation to return.
full_text: Open one recent meeting note and separate decisions, owners, and dates into clear items. Anything unresolved should be labeled as an open question rather than buried in the narrative.

title: Trace One Important Claim to Its Primary Source
teaser: Summaries are efficient, but missing context can change the meaning of technical or financial information.
full_text: For one consequential claim you find today, locate the original source when possible. Check its date, scope, assumptions, and exceptions before relying on a secondary summary.

title: Simplify Before You Automate
teaser: Automation can repeat unnecessary complexity faster and more consistently.
full_text: Before automating one recurring task, remove redundant steps, duplicate data entry, and avoidable decisions. Build the simplest reliable manual flow first, then automate the repetition that remains.

title: Make One Weekly Success Reusable
teaser: A good result is more valuable when the method can be repeated without rediscovery.
full_text: Identify one approach, check, or message that worked especially well this week. Turn it into a short template or note so future work can start from evidence rather than memory.

title: Write the Assumption Beside the Decision
teaser: A decision and the assumption behind it should not disappear into the same sentence.
full_text: For one meaningful choice today, record the most important assumption separately. If that assumption later changes, it should be obvious that the decision deserves another look.

title: Verify the Restore Path, Not Just the Backup
teaser: A backup only reduces risk if you know how to recover from it.
full_text: For one important set of data, confirm where the backup lives, how it can be opened or restored, and what version it represents. Do not treat a successful copy operation as proof of recoverability.

title: Update One Expectation Before Month-End
teaser: Silently carrying an outdated promise into a new month can damage trust more than the change itself.
full_text: If an April estimate for time, cost, or output has changed, communicate the new state before the month closes. Separate the reason for the change from the revised expectation.

title: Close April with a Decision Review
teaser: Monthly learning includes reviewing the choices that shaped the work, not only the tasks that were completed.
full_text: List three consequential decisions you made in April, what information they relied on, and whether you would make the same choice today. Use the patterns you notice to prepare better inputs for May.
